Description: Generic reusable HAL with a single multi-reagent source plate (Source_1, wells A1-A4) and a HeaterShaker module for temperature-sensitive reagents.

Source_1.DisplayName: Source_1 - Reagent plate (A1=GEL-N3, A2=HA-N3, A3=4arm-20kPEG-DBCO, A4+A5=Solvent split)

Metadata.note: All 4 reagents are loaded into wells A1-A4 of the single Source_1 24-well plate; Solvent (well A4) exceeds a single well's 3.4mL capacity so it is split across A4+A5 in the recipe. Source_1 must return to slot C2 after each HeaterShaker cycle (D2 is occupied by TargetPlate).
